content.en: The **Universal Postal Union (UPU)**, established by the Treaty of Bern in 1874, serves as the primary forum for cooperation between postal sector players. It ensures a truly universal network of up-to-date products and services. For the **Indian Economy**, the UPU provides the framework for the Department of Posts to exchange international mail efficiently.
